source.sectionTitle: Calcium Channel Blocker and Beta-Blocker Overdose

record.item: Calcium Channel Blocker and Beta-Blocker Overdose (CMJAH)

symptoms: Hypotension, bradycardia, conduction heart blocks, hyperglycaemia, metabolic acidosis

management_steps.details: Activated Charcoal: 50g via NGT if presentation < 1 hour. Crystalloid fluid bolus 20mg/kg [printed as mg/kg in source document].

1. Dextrose pre-load: 50ml 50% Dextrose IV bolus.
2. Actrapid loading dose: 1 IU/kg IV STAT bolus.
3. Actrapid infusion: 0.5 IU/kg/hr, titrate up to max 10 IU/kg/hr.
4. Dextrose maintenance: 25g/hr (50ml 50% Dextrose OR 100ml 25% Dextrose per hour).
Calcium Chloride 10%: 10 ml IV over 10 minutes.

warnings: Source prints crystalloid bolus as '20mg/kg' instead of ml/kg (flagged in errata).
